spam_number='5708520672'
phone_access_token=res['access_token']

# Fetch all text messages from spam_number
all_text_msgs=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page = apis.phone.search_text_messages(access_token=phone_access_token, phone_number=spam_number, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('text page', page_index, 'len', len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    all_text_msgs.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

text_ids=[m['text_message_id'] for m in all_text_msgs]
print('total_text_msgs', len(all_text_msgs))
print('text_ids_first_last', text_ids[:3], text_ids[-3:] if len(text_ids)>=3 else text_ids)
